2026-09-25PSHigh Risk Child Sex Offender Database ActHigh Risk Child Sex Offender Database RegulationsHigh Risk Child Sex Offender Database Regulations in order to (1) require that the Commissioner review the information in the database by December 31 of the calendar year in which the regulations come into force, and then at least once every calendar year; and (2) establish 30 days as the period within which, if a decision is not made for the purposes of an application to remove information from the database, the Commissioner is deemed to have decided not to remove the information.Registration: SOR/2026-0202 Publication Date: 2026-10-07
act: High Risk Child Sex Offender Database Act
subject: High Risk Child Sex Offender Database Regulations
precis: High Risk Child Sex Offender Database Regulations in order to (1) require that the Commissioner review the information in the database by December 31 of the calendar year in which the regulations come into force, and then at least once every calendar year; and (2) establish 30 days as the period within which, if a decision is not made for the purposes of an application to remove information from the database, the Commissioner is deemed to have decided not to remove the information.
